title: System
backupDescription: Copies the live database to the backup directory using SQLite's own online backup API, safe to run while cameras are writing.
purgeDescription: Deletes history and alert rows older than the retention window. Always preview first - nothing is deleted until you type the confirmation word below.
purgeTypeToConfirm: Type {{word}} to confirm this will permanently delete the rows above
clockSuspectWarning: The system clock is not synchronised. Records written now are flagged as untrustworthy and excluded from reports.
